parameters.name: --server
parameters.description: Host name or address of the iperf3 endpoint. Without it the one from the deployed profile.

parameters.name: --port
parameters.description: Port of the iperf3 endpoint. Without it the one from the deployed profile, or 5201.

parameters.name: --download-mbit
parameters.description: Download target in megabit per second.

parameters.name: --upload-mbit
parameters.description: Upload target in megabit per second.

parameters.name: --udp
parameters.description: Measure with UDP: reports packet loss and jitter instead of retransmits and latency.

parameters.name: --username
parameters.description: User name for the endpoint's authentication. Without it the one from the deployed profile, and without that the sensor measures unauthenticated.

parameters.name: --password
parameters.description: Password, for probes where no credentials file can be placed. Left out, the sensor reads the one deployed on this probe.

parameters.name: --public-key
parameters.description: Path to the endpoint's public key, if it is not in the deployed profile.

parameters.name: --profile
parameters.description: Name of the deployed credential profile. Use one per endpoint when they have different passwords.

parameters.name: --seconds
parameters.description: How long to transfer per direction. The default of 5 was measured; longer runs read lower on a line that shapes after a burst.

parameters.name: --measure-every-minutes
parameters.description: Minimum minutes between two real measurements.

parameters.name: --timeout-seconds
parameters.description: The time budget for the whole test in seconds.

parameters.name: --self-check
parameters.description: Only verify that the sensor is able to run.
